#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

test_names="test tests spec specs __tests__"

is_test_name() {
    local name=$1
    case " $test_names " in
        *" $name "*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

while IFS= read -r dir; do
    case "$dir" in
        */.git/*) continue ;;
    esac
    base=$(basename "$dir")
    if is_test_name "$base"; then
        continue
    fi
    found=0
    for tn in $test_names; do
        if [ -d "./$tn/$base" ]; then
            found=1
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ $found -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: Source directory '$dir' has no corresponding test directory."
        exit 1
    fi
done < <(find . -type d ! -path './.git/*')

exit 0
